Description: [Raid Teleporters] Silver Sable - Age of Ultron teleporter (replaces Captain America Ally, Domino, Manifold, Songbird - see history: Domino/Manifold/Songbird's models weren't cooked into the client UPKs; Captain America Ally's model IS cooked but her UnrealClass is MarvelAgent_-prefixed, which the client treats as an ally/summon-type entity and never offers the interact prompt for at all, confirmed via a live trace - no client interact request was ever sent for her). Silver Sable's own model (MarvelNPC_SilverSable, confirmed cooked into the client UPKs) was previously only used by SilverSableHelicarrier.prototype (placed on the Helicarrier) and by two of our own Midtown vendor patches (MidtownACCTrainer/MidtownVendorWeapon, both natively skinned as Silver Sable) - those two vendor patches were repointed to MidtownVendorCostume instead (see PatchDataMod_Vendors_AnniversaryVendor.json and Off/PatchDataMod_Vendors_SummerFunVendor.json), freeing this exact prototype (Entity/Characters/NPCs/SilverSable.prototype, the non-Helicarrier variant) for reuse with zero visual duplication anywhere else in the game. Native DesignState is NotInGame - flip to Live.

[Raid Teleporters] Age of Ultron teleporter - place Silver Sable at this marker slot. Marker 0's native LastKnownEntityName was SpawnMarkers/Types/EncounterTinyV3.prototype - a generic encounter spawn placeholder, same reusable category as markers 30/31/32 (already repurposed for the EG Patrol teleporters), not a fixed named NPC.
[Raid Teleporters] Age of Ultron teleporter - final placement position in Avengers Tower, confirmed live.

[Raid Teleporters] Age of Ultron teleporter - rotation zeroed out per the same convention as the EG Patrol teleporters, so the correct final rotation can be judged fresh from a known (0,0,0) baseline.

[Raid Teleporters] Domino - Axis Raid teleporter (moved here from Age of Ultron - her model IS cooked into the client UPKs and she renders fine, just thematically fits an X-Men-affiliated raid better than Ultron). Native DesignState is NotInGame - flip to Live. Confirmed safe to reuse: 0 prototype-data references anywhere in the game, 0 cell-marker placements anywhere.

[Raid Teleporters] Axis Raid teleporter - place Domino at this marker slot (previously Manifold, whose model wasn't cooked into the client UPKs). Marker 19's native LastKnownEntityName was SpawnMarkers/Types/EncounterSmall.prototype - a generic encounter spawn placeholder, not a fixed named NPC.
[Raid Teleporters] Axis Raid teleporter - final placement position in Avengers Tower, confirmed live.
[Raid Teleporters] Axis Raid teleporter - rotation zeroed out per the same convention as the EG Patrol teleporters.

[Raid Teleporters] Valkyrie - Surtur Raid teleporter (replaces Songbird, whose model wasn't cooked into the client UPKs). Valkyrie's model (MarvelNPC_Valkyrie) is confirmed cooked into the client UPKs, thematically fits an Asgard-set raid, and is confirmed safe to reuse: 0 prototype-data references anywhere in the game, 0 cell-marker placements anywhere. Native DesignState is NotInGame - flip to Live.

[Raid Teleporters] Surtur Raid teleporter - place Valkyrie at this marker slot. Marker 23's native LastKnownEntityName was SpawnMarkers/Types/EncounterTinyV2.prototype - a generic encounter spawn placeholder, not a fixed named NPC.
[Raid Teleporters] Surtur Raid teleporter - final placement position in Avengers Tower, confirmed live.
[Raid Teleporters] Surtur Raid teleporter - rotation zeroed out per the same convention as the EG Patrol teleporters.

[Axis Raid] Native AccessDifficulties only grants Tier2Heroic. Same fix as UltronRaidRegionCosmic's AccessDifficulties patch (PatchDataMod_Difficulty_Raid_AgeofUltron.json) - appends Tier4Cosmic access so the new Axis Raid teleporter's forced T4 entry survives the internal stage-to-boss-arena transition (TeleportContext_Transition), not just the initial debug-teleport bypass on entry.
[Axis Raid] Same fix as the Tier4Cosmic entry above - appends Tier5Omega1 access so the T5 option survives the internal transition too.
